source_text: These trials prompted World Health Organization (WHO) recommendations in 2007 for voluntary medical male circumcision (VMMC) programs in 15 priority sub-Saharan African countries with HIV prevalence exceeding 15% among adolescent girls and young women, estimating potential prevention of 3.4 million HIV infections and 1.3 million deaths by 2025 if scaled appropriately. [144]
